notes: This draft manifest is not yet promoted into the primary phase06_ui_sample_manifest.json.
Its purpose is to extend the regular Phase06 source supply beyond the exhausted current public cangjiechallenge pool while the regular checkpoint holds at 35/35 live passed.

The official HarmonyOS-Examples repo still contains multiple unconsumed single-file CommonUI pages at commit f29257acc564b5daedaba4c32b0f9530b3fc0c31; this draft freezes three low-coupling ArkUI page-shell candidates with no hybrid/web/bridge dependency pressure.

ordered_samples.usage_goal: Add a self-contained typography controls page that keeps text content, font size, weight, and style toggles inside one page-owned render state boundary.

source.purpose: P7 draft candidate harvested from the already approved HarmonyOS-Examples pinned repo after the regular Phase06 supply reached 35/35 live passed and the public cangjiechallenge pool was exhausted.

blocking_constraints: Keep text/font state and button plus checkbox event wiring source-backed inside the page boundary; do not invent detached controllers or helper layers.

ordered_samples.usage_goal: Add a self-contained slider demo page that keeps four slider values, orientation variants, and readback labels inside one render-facing page boundary.

blocking_constraints: Keep slider value ownership and onChange readback inside the same page shell instead of introducing synthetic view models or controller wrappers.

ordered_samples.usage_goal: Add a self-contained vertical tabs page that keeps the TabsController host and tab content boundary inside one controller-owned page shell.

tag_rules.resolution_rule: Each file-level sample must resolve to exactly one structure_tag and one ownership_tag. interaction/exception/sample_scope tags are additive only.
